senses.gloss: Vemacitrin (also ˚tra, q.v., 2, and Vaimacitra; = Pali Vepacitti), n. of a prince of the asuras: ˚trī, n. sg., LV 〔241.3〕; Mv 〔iii.138.2〕; 〔254.9〕; Divy 〔182.13〕; Av 〔i.108.10〕; ˚trir, n. sg., Divy 〔126.8〕; ˚triṇā (v.l. ˚treṇa) SP 〔5.3〕; ˚citri- (stem) Mmk 〔655.11〕; 〔663.21〕.
vemātra, m., a high number: Mvy 〔7756〕 = Tib. gzhal saṅs; cf. vimantra (also vaimātra, which must be distinguished from this).
